card.name: Intellectual as a quality word
card.fires_on: The word intellectual (or cognitive, mentally) in essays about thinking, learning and academic values, where a virtue or trait noun like honesty or arrogance may come next. Also weaker on small words in quotes about writing or creativity.

modes.label: Intellectual before a trait
modes.description: The adjective intellectual or similar word sits before a quality noun such as honesty, risks, or arrogance.
modes.example: free inquiry,<< intellectual>> honesty, respect for the dignity of others

modes.label: Other mind-related words
modes.description: Cognitive or mentally appear in talk of mental effort or growth.
modes.example: doing this kind of<< cognitive>> heavy lifting.

modes.label: Small words in reflective quotes
modes.description: Short words in aphorisms about writing and creativity.
modes.example: “Writing is<< a>> way of talking without being interrupted.”

card.writes: It pushes toward virtue and character nouns like honesty, humility, discipline, and elite.
card.plain: It fires on the word intellectual in essays about thinking and academic values, expecting a trait like honesty to follow.
